biggest_catch: Election Day is a mandatory all-day commitment (~7am-9pm, must remain at polling place all day) with mandatory pre-election training, and payment arrives 3-6 weeks later by mailed check.
catches: Full-day commitment: arrive ~7am, stay until ~9pm or later; cannot leave polling place.
Mandatory training required before each election (in-person classes typically ~2 hours).
Pay arrives by mailed check 3-6 weeks after Election Day.
Must be U.S. citizen, at least 16; students limited to 2 per precinct with parent permission.

steps: Apply to be a poll worker at adacountyelections.com.
Attend mandatory training before the election (in-person classes typically ~2 hours).
Work Election Day: arrive by 7am, remain at polling place until ~9pm or later.
Receive $150 (or $175-$200 as chief; district judges $16/hr + mileage) by check 3-6 weeks later.
timing: Election Day ~7:00am to ~9:00pm (full day, cannot leave polling place). Mandatory training before each election, in-person classes typically ~2 hours.
